articleTitle: Does Blending Leafy Greens Retain the Same Nutrients?
imageHeadline: Blending Spinach & Kale: What Happens to Fiber & Nutrients?
imageSubtext: See exactly what changes when you blend instead of chew
pinTitle: Does blending spinach and kale destroy nutrients? What actually happens to fiber in smoothies
pinDescription: If you blend leafy greens like spinach or kale into smoothies, here's what happens to the fiber and nutrients compared to eating them whole. Learn which nutrients stay intact, what changes during blending, and how your body absorbs blended greens differently. Get the full breakdown on the site.
